plugin.name: Endfield Assistant
plugin.description: Arknights: Endfield game assistant: companion assist (chat companion on by default; automatic stuck reminders with macro / detailed layered advice), scene classification (33 classes), YOLO item detection, OCR text recognition, task catalog and MAA task orchestration, daily task planning, and direct event-stream reading. The recognition and assist layers are read-only: they do not touch the game process, inject input or upload data; execution entries are behind the allow_run gate (off by default). The battle event stream (ZMDLogs child process) captures game traffic at the network-adapter level and is behind the zmdlogs_enabled gate (off by default).
plugin.short_description: Endfield companion: stuck-assist (auto-triggered, layered advice), scene classify (33 classes), YOLO detect, OCR, task catalog, daily orchestrator (read-only by default). Optional ZMDLogs battle-event stream captures traffic at the network-adapter level, behind its own gate (off by default).
maaend.plugin.name: MaaEnd Endfield Bridge
maaend.plugin.description: Bridges MaaEnd / MaaFramework (Arknights: Endfield automation) into N.E.K.O.: detect the install, list tasks from interface.json (following imports), and execute via MaaEnd's bundled official runner MaaPiCli (-d direct mode, full PI v2.5.0 semantics) behind a consent gate. The official runner does the executing; this plugin ships zero third-party dependencies.
maaend.entry.ef_adb.name: ADB device
maaend.entry.ef_adb.description: List ADB devices or take a device screenshot (mobile / emulator capture). action=list|screenshot; screenshots are saved under data/adb/.
maaend.entry.ef_agent.name: Vision agent takeover
maaend.entry.ef_agent.description: M3: switch the suite mode and start the NitroGen vision agent to play (general purpose, no completion guarantee). Dangerous: confirm must be true (explicit user consent). Stop with ef_stop_task.
maaend.entry.ef_assist.name: Companion assist
maaend.entry.ef_assist.description: Chat companion (on by default) + stuck assist. action=state / config / set / check / advice. Read-only subscription to local event streams: never clicks, injects input, or takes over the game.
maaend.entry.ef_decide.name: Decision dispatch
maaend.entry.ef_decide.description: Route requests like 'do my Endfield dailies' through the decision layer ranking and return candidate tasks with reasons; run=true executes the top candidate (same gate and mutual exclusion as ef_run_task).
maaend.entry.ef_endaxis.name: Rotation presets
maaend.entry.ef_endaxis.description: Three Endaxis rotation presets (Starter / Elite / BOSS). action=list / code (share code for MaaEnd axis settings) / run (via RealTimeTask, same gate and mutual exclusion as ef_run_task).
maaend.entry.ef_list_tasks.name: Task catalog
maaend.entry.ef_list_tasks.description: List every task declared by the installed MaaEnd interface.json (name, entry node, description, option definitions with selectable cases).
maaend.entry.ef_modes.name: Execution mode ladder
maaend.entry.ef_modes.description: Six-mode probe summary (M0 read-only companion / M1 MaaEndControl / M2 built-in PiRunner / M3 NitroGen / M4 human-assist / M5 operation replay): availability, chosen mode and reason. Read-only; starts no processes.
maaend.entry.ef_ocr.name: Screen OCR
maaend.entry.ef_ocr.description: OCR the Endfield window (rapidocr sidecar; brings the game to the foreground): returns full_text and per-line results; roi=[x1,y1,x2,y2] narrows the region.
maaend.entry.ef_open_app.name: Open MaaEnd
maaend.entry.ef_remind.name: Set reminder
maaend.entry.ef_remind.description: M4 human-assist: set a reminder with push on fire. kind=after_task / at_time (daily HH:MM) / in_minutes (N minutes) / ocr_text (text appears on screen). Session memory only; cleared on plugin reload.
maaend.entry.ef_reminders.name: Reminder list
maaend.entry.ef_reminders.description: List or cancel M4 reminders. action=list (default, includes fired history); action=cancel with id.
maaend.entry.ef_report.name: Battle review
maaend.entry.ef_report.description: Read the most recent ZMDLogs session event streams and render a Markdown battle report (count / duration / damage / deaths / skills / failure verdicts and attributions). Read-only: no subscription, no input, no files written.
maaend.entry.ef_replay.name: Operation replay (M5)
maaend.entry.ef_replay.description: Ask operation_learner to replay a previously learned operation (teaching / explore / stream). dry_run=true (default) validates only; dry_run=false injects real input and requires the allow_run gate plus confirm=true.
maaend.entry.ef_run_task.name: Run task
maaend.entry.ef_run_task.description: Generate a PI config for the chosen task and launch the official MaaPiCli runner (-d direct mode, full PI v2.5.0 semantics: option cases, agent child processes). Returns immediately; poll task_state, stop with stop_task.
maaend.entry.ef_scene_status.name: Scene model status
maaend.entry.ef_scene_status.description: Whether the scene classifier is ready: model path, class table, load time. Run this first when ef_scene errors.
maaend.entry.ef_status.name: Status
maaend.entry.ef_status.description: Probe the MaaEnd install and runtime: install path, bundled MaaFramework version (read live from the DLL), task-catalog size, whether the Endfield game window is online, and the run gate.
maaend.entry.ef_stop_task.name: Stop runner
maaend.entry.ef_stop_task.description: Terminate the MaaPiCli runner process (the task stops; the game itself is untouched).
maaend.entry.ef_stream.name: Stream read
maaend.entry.ef_stream.description: Read this plugin's data stream (tasks / window / yolo). Pass the previous latest_id as since for incremental reads; callable cross-plugin.
maaend.entry.ef_suite.name: Suite overview
maaend.entry.ef_suite.description: Game-plugin suite overview: decision layer (game_decision) status, NitroGen agent, suite mode arbitration, this plugin's execution state and official links. Read-only.
maaend.entry.ef_task_state.name: Runner progress
maaend.entry.ef_task_state.description: Report the MaaPiCli runner state: running / exited (code) plus the tail of its output log.
maaend.entry.ef_yolo.name: YOLO detect
maaend.entry.ef_yolo.description: Take a screenshot now and run YOLO object detection (callable cross-plugin). Returns objects[{label,confidence,box}].
maaend.entry.ef_zmdlogs_status.name: Battle event stream status
maaend.entry.ef_zmdlogs_status.descripti: Status of the ZMDLogs battle event stream (damage / combo / buff): gate, source checkout, Npcap, RSA key, child process liveness, WS port and recent stderr. Run this first when stuck-assist has no data or the stream will not start. action=start launches the child process explicitly (still subject to the gate), action=stop stops it.
